events.title: Chanukah @ Islanders
events.about: Chanukah night at the Islanders game with the CTeen Great Neck crew. Sign up here so we know you're coming, then get your ticket on the CTeen portal.

events.title: Leadership Summit Atlanta
events.about: Hands-on leadership workshops with real-world skills to bring back to Great Neck: program planning, crisis response training, team management and delegation, plus talks from leaders who saw a need in the Jewish community and filled it.

events.title: International Shabbaton
events.about: The biggest weekend of the CTeen year. Thousands of Jewish teens from around the world take over New York for a Shabbat of inspiration, Jewish pride and unity.

challenges.title: Tefillin Challenge
challenges.about: Wrap tefillin, check in, build your streak. Shabbat doesn't break it.

challenges.title: Shabbat Candles Challenge
challenges.about: Light Shabbat candles on Friday before sunset, then check in. One check-in a week.

posts.title: Chanukah @ Islanders: sign-ups are open
posts.body: Light up the rink with us on Dec 10 – 11. Tickets start at $55. Sign up in the app so we save you a spot.

posts.title: New: the Tefillin Challenge
posts.body: Check in every day you wrap. Hit the milestones, win prizes, climb the Great Neck leaderboard.

posts.title: Chanukah starts Friday night, Dec 4
posts.body: Eight nights, Dec 4 – 12. On Friday, light the menorah before Shabbat candles.

posts.title: International Shabbaton is on the calendar
posts.body: Feb 25 – 28, 2027 in New York. Registration is on the CTeen website and goes through the chapter for approval, so sign up early.

posts.title: Volunteered? Log your community service hours
posts.body: Log the hours you served, the chapter verifies them, and they land on a transcript you can hand to your school.

info.title: Where we meet
info.body: Chabad of Great Neck, 400 East Shore Road, Great Neck, NY 11024.

info.title: Who runs it
info.body: Rabbi Zevy & Shani Geisinsky lead CTeen Great Neck. Say hi any time: CTeen swag, Shabbos meals and events are always on.

info.title: What is CTeen?
info.body: The Chabad Teen Network: the largest Jewish teen network in the world, with about 900 chapters in 64 countries and 200,000 members. Great Neck is one of them.

info.title: High School Club
info.body: CTeen at your high school: kosher food, friends and giving back. Ask Rabbi Zevy when the next one is.

info.title: CTeen U
info.body: Explore Torah and earn 3 college credits while you're still in high school. Details at cteenu.com.
